about.headline: A long-held dream, realised in Claremont.
about.body: While working in clinics around the world, Emma and Daniel shaped a vision: excellent care for pets and friendly, personalised advice for owners. Claremont Veterinary Surgery is that vision — now shared with Drs Kate New Tolley and Natalie Jones. Reception lead Kat Mitchell (Cert IV veterinary nurse) anchors a nursing team of Rhianna, Chantelle, Stella, and Sam, supported by animal attendants Danielle and Sophie. The clinic supports local groups including the Dog's Home of Tasmania and Hobart Fe
